import pytest
from fastapi import FastAPI
from argus.backend import metrics_labels

def _labels(**headers):
    from starlette.requests import Request
    req = Request({'type': 'http', 'headers': [(k.lower().encode(), v.encode()) for k, v in headers.items()]})
    return {name: getattr(metrics_labels, name)(request=req) for name in ('ssh_tunnel', 'build_id', 'job_name', 'branch', 'client_version')}

def test_tunneled_ci_request_is_attributed_to_its_job():
    labels = _labels(**{'X-SSH-Tunnel-Origin': 'argus-tunnel-1.example.com', 'X-Argus-Build-Id': 'scylla-master/byo/byo_build_tests_dtest#42', 'X-Argus-Client-Version': '0.16.1'})
    assert labels == {'ssh_tunnel': 'yes', 'build_id': 'scylla-master/byo/byo_build_tests_dtest#42', 'job_name': 'scylla-master/byo/byo_build_tests_dtest', 'branch': 'scylla-master', 'client_version': '0.16.1'}

def test_direct_ci_request_is_attributed_to_its_job():
    """The case the metrics could not express before: a job skipping the tunnel."""
    labels = _labels(**{'X-Argus-Build-Id': 'scylla-2026.1/gating-dtest-release-with-tablets#7', 'X-Argus-Client-Version': '0.15.7'})
    assert labels == {'ssh_tunnel': 'no', 'build_id': 'scylla-2026.1/gating-dtest-release-with-tablets#7', 'job_name': 'scylla-2026.1/gating-dtest-release-with-tablets', 'branch': 'scylla-2026.1', 'client_version': '0.15.7'}

def test_request_without_attribution_is_unknown():
    assert _labels() == {'ssh_tunnel': 'no', 'build_id': 'unknown', 'job_name': 'unknown', 'branch': 'unknown', 'client_version': 'unknown'}

@pytest.mark.parametrize('build_id, expected_job', [('job#42', 'job'), ('folder/job#with#hash#7', 'folder/job#with#hash'), ('manual-run', 'manual-run'), ('release-2.1', 'release-2.1')])

    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, env=env)
    print(result.stdout)
    return result

    """Fixture to build and install the package."""

#!/bin/bash
# argus-original sync|start|stop|status|seed
# The original Flask application (State A) on its own wheel set, runnable as the behavioural oracle.
# It serves on http://127.0.0.1:8010 under uWSGI from /opt/argus-original, with its own keyspace
# argus_original on the local database (start that first with: argus-db start).
set -euo pipefail
root=/opt/argus-original
venv=$root/.venv
home="${ARGUS_ORIGINAL_HOME:-$HOME/.argus-original}"
port="${ARGUS_ORIGINAL_PORT:-8010}"
pidfile="$home/uwsgi.pid"
mkdir -p "$home/metrics"
export CQLENG_ALLOW_SCHEMA_MANAGEMENT=1 PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR="$home/metrics" PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
running() { [[ -f "$pidfile" ]] && kill -0 "$(cat "$pidfile")" 2>/dev/null; }
keyspace() {
  /usr/bin/cqlsh -u cassandra -p cassandra -e \
    "CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS argus_original WITH replication = {'class': 'NetworkTopologyStrategy', 'replication_factor': 1};
     CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS argus_tablets WITH replication = {'class': 'NetworkTopologyStrategy', 'replication_factor': 1} AND tablets = {'enabled': true};"
}
case "${1:-status}" in
  sync)
    keyspace
    cd "$root" && exec "$venv/bin/flask" --app argus_backend:argus_app cli sync-models ;;
  seed)
    shift; cd "$root" && PYTHONPATH="$root" exec "$venv/bin/python" dev-db/seed_data.py "$@" ;;
  start)
    if running; then echo "argus-original: already running on 127.0.0.1:$port"; exit 0; fi
    cd "$root"
    "$venv/bin/uwsgi" --http-socket "127.0.0.1:$port" --master --processes 1 --threads 100 \
      --enable-threads --lazy-apps --single-interpreter --manage-script-name \
      --mount /=argus_backend:argus_app --buffer-size 48000 --need-app \
      --env "PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR=$home/metrics" \
      --pidfile "$pidfile" --daemonize "$home/uwsgi.log"
    for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
      if "$venv/bin/python" -c "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:$port/auth/login').status == 200 else 1)" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "argus-original: serving on http://127.0.0.1:$port"; exit 0
      fi
      sleep 1
    done
    echo "argus-original: not serving after 60 s; see $home/uwsgi.log" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  stop)
    if running; then "$venv/bin/uwsgi" --stop "$pidfile" || true; fi
    rm -f "$pidfile"; echo "argus-original: stopped" ;;
  status)
    if running; then echo "argus-original: running on 127.0.0.1:$port"; else echo "argus-original: not running"; exit 1; fi ;;
  *) echo "usage: argus-original sync|seed [seed_data.py options]|start|stop|status" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
